description: Uploads a project folder and puts it online — a new project or a new version of an existing one. Detects the stack (Python, Node, Go, Rust, PHP, static HTML, Docker, docker-compose), asks for missing secrets, waits for the build and returns the URL or the failure reason. A new project takes a name; an existing one is updated by project_id. When the code needs secrets that are not set yet, the result is needs_secrets with their names, and values go in “secrets”. A build takes 1-5 minutes.

comment.description: Short note for the version history, e.g. "fix /start handler"

name.description: Name for a NEW project (becomes part of the URL). Omit when updating an existing project.

path.description: Absolute path to the project folder on this machine

project_id.description: Existing project to update. Omit to create a new one.

secrets.description: Secrets as {"BOT_TOKEN": "123:abc"}. Stored encrypted; delivered to the app as environment variables via .env.

skip_secrets.description: Publish even though the code seems to read env variables that were not provided. Use only after the user confirmed the app does not need them.

wait.description: Wait for the build to finish (up to wait_seconds). false = return right after upload.

name: netrun_publish
title: Publish to Netrun
